messages.subject: [Diagnosismed-list] school teaching microscope
messages.body_plain:
Dear Manager,
 
It`s my pleasure to write to you.
 
We are a manufacturer of over 60-year history for microscopes and lens, with registered capital of 10M US Dollars.
Our company is the birthplace of the first Chinese biological microscope, the first aero photographic apparatus and the first electron microscope, we therefore are honored as the cradle of Chinese Optoelectronics.
 
To expand our business, we are now looking for partners for long-term cooperation, We make wide rang of microscopes, they are CE and TUV approved, I hope we can work with you in the near future.
 
Best regards,
Sam Tau
 
JIANGAN NOVLE OPTICS CO., LTD.
#9 Handa Rd., Economic Development Zone, Nanjing
